name: Progress
description: Linear progress indicator using Radix UI Progress primitive. Thin track (h-1) with primary-colored indicator. Used for learning progress, sync status, and level/experience display.

variantDimensions.name: value
variantDimensions.description: Numeric progress value from 0 to 100. Controls indicator width via translateX transform.

anatomy.description: Root container (ProgressPrimitive.Root) with bg-muted, h-1, w-full, rounded-full, overflow-x-hidden
Indicator (ProgressPrimitive.Indicator) with bg-primary, size-full, flex-1, transition-all

structurePatterns: Indicator uses translateX transform: translateX(-${100 - value}%)
usageHints: Use for course completion rate in dashboard
Use for lesson/chapter progress in course detail
Use for experience/level progress in achievements
Use for sync status indicator in desktop client
Value 0 shows empty track, value 100 shows full primary fill
Thin height (h-1) is intentional for inline progress display
doNotInvent: Do not add labels inside the progress bar
Do not change height beyond h-1 without explicit design need
Do not add gradient to indicator (use solid --color-primary)
unknowns: Stepped/segmented progress not defined in source
Color variant for error state not in source component
